# northflank_domain_verification (Resource)

Waits until Northflank has verified ownership of a domain registered with `northflank_domain`, retrying while the TXT record propagates. Make it depend on the DNS record, and use its `domain` for `northflank_subdomain`, which needs a verified domain.

Destroying this resource does not unverify anything; it only forgets the verification.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "northflank_domain" "root" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

# Create the TXT record northflank_domain.root asks for, with any DNS provider,
# then wait for Northflank to see it.
resource "northflank_domain_verification" "root" {
  domain  = northflank_domain.root.domain
  timeout = "30m"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Root domain, as registered with `northflank_domain`.

### Optional

- `timeout` (String) How long to keep retrying while the DNS record propagates, as a duration such as `30m`. Defaults to `20m`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The verified domain, or `<domain>/<subdomain>`.
